```yaml
name: PR Template Check

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, edited]

jobs:
  check_pr_template:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Check PR template
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}" != *"## Description"* ]]; then
            echo "PR description does not follow the template"
            exit 1
          fi

  build_and_test:
    needs: check_pr_template
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [18.x, 20.x]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Use Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
          cache: 'npm'
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npm test
      - name: Publish test results
        uses: EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action@v2
        if: always()
        with:
          files: test-results.xml

  publish_documentation_netlify:
    needs: build_and_test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18.x'
      - run: npm ci
      - name: Build documentation
        run: npm run docs:build
      - name: Deploy to Netlify
        run: |
          DRAFT_BUILD=false
          if [ "${{ github.ref }}" != "refs/heads/main" ]; then
            DRAFT_BUILD=true
          fi
          curl -X POST https://api.netlify.com/api/v1/sites/${{ secrets.NETLIFY_SITE_ID }}/deploys \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.NETLIFY_DEPLOY_KEY }}" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "{\"deploy\": {\"draft\": ${DRAFT_BUILD}, \"files\": {\"public/index.html\": \"index.html\"}}}"
```
